primary.title: Worried about mutual fund losses? Expert shares 5 ways to reduce portfolio risk and navigate equity market volatility
primary.summary: Check out 5 expert-backed ways to reduce risk in your mutual fund portfolio, including asset allocation, diversification, continuing SIPs and periodic rebalancing. Paisabazaar's Tushar Gupta explains how investors can manage market volatility and stay focused on long-term financial goals.
